augments_not_replaces: all 22 original scenarios with unchanged expectations
boundary: Consumer-visible boundary only: the installed postchecker's verdict, native exit and named refusal mechanism. No assertion about source wiring, counts or wording beyond the named mechanism.
pass_rule_if_ever_exercised: A case passes only if verdict FAIL, exit 1 and the named mechanism. Exit 2, PASS or a different mechanism is HOLD for investigation.
execution: None performed or authorized; requires a separately approved harness and the Main-owned migration/installation.

cases.base_bundle: launched original22 bundle with a completed census measurement whose initial and final full identities are equal
cases.mutation: identity_event_ref := identity_after_event_ref; mono_task_begin = mono_task_end = final event mono_begin = mono_end = t
cases.keep_consistent: a genuine earlier current-census before_task_event_ref; history, interval and measurement fields reconciled

expected.mechanism: Invalid('actual task/identity brackets do not causally enclose the measurement')

cases.base_bundle: launched original22 bundle with a post-baseline owned_group registration of a non-baseline incarnation P
cases.mutation: P's registration reference event: unproved=false and mono_end = registration first_seen_mono = t; P omitted from unproved_history
cases.keep_consistent: P kept in its census owned_live; registration, variants, counts and references reconciled

expected.mechanism: Invalid('post-baseline unrooted acquisition omitted from unproved coverage')

cases.base_bundle: launched original22 bundle whose completed census lists the non-zombie owned MAIN with euid/ruid equal to receipt uid
cases.mutation: remove that MAIN measurement; lane_pids/lane_busy_pids/lane_rss/lane_busy and mono_last_observation set to the reduced totals
cases.keep_consistent: complete=true, incomplete_n=0, incomplete=[]; MAIN owned_live identity, event reference and current copies kept

expected.mechanism: Invalid('completed census omits a mandatory owned/unproved native measurement')

cases.base_bundle: ownership_group bundle with the intended descendant registered via owned_group
cases.mutation: the descendant's registry identity_event_ref := an earlier same-identity acquisition retained before the MAIN anchor acquisition
cases.keep_consistent: first_seen_mono later than the MAIN registration; PGID equal to the MAIN PGID; tape and counts reconciled

expected.mechanism: Invalid('owned-group registration not rooted in the actual known group')

cases.mutation: receipt main_initial_identity_event_ref removed, or pointed at a MAIN-identity event beginning before receipt mono_spawn (registry root entry moved with it)
cases.keep_consistent: registry, tape and current copies otherwise consistent

expected.mechanism: Invalid('MAIN root registration not anchored to its actual post-spawn initial acquisition')

cases.base_bundle: helper_overrun bundle with an identity-checked sent helper TERM, rc=-15 and complete settlement
cases.mutation: term_attempted := false (mirrored in the current reconciliation helpers)
cases.keep_consistent: all signal, wait, deadline and settlement fields unchanged

cases.base_bundle: zombie_hold bundle with a matched status-5 zombie_hold_start observation and a successful zombie join
cases.mutation: zombie join precheck.target identity.status := 2 and both short-bracket statuses := 2
cases.keep_consistent: PID, uniqueid, idversion, credentials, parent, group, trace, comm, observer and chronology unchanged; original intermediate bytes, merge and digests reconciled

expected.mechanism: Invalid('held zombie returned to a live state in its pre-wait evidence')

cases.base_bundle: any bundle with a successful private join of calls=2 (first call returned [0,0] normally, last call reaped)
cases.keep_consistent: calls, first/last call records, wait status and timestamps unchanged; serialized original bytes and digests reconciled

expected.mechanism: Invalid('private join interruption count contradicts its retained native wait calls')

cases.base_bundle: any bundle with a successful private join of calls=3 whose first call returned normally
cases.keep_consistent: endpoint records unchanged; serialized original bytes and digests reconciled

expected.mechanism: Invalid('private join interruption count contradicts its retained native wait calls')
